## Users Portfolio Tags
Users Portfolio Tags associates text tags with individual portfolio photos uploaded by members. Each record links a tag string to a specific photo and user, enabling keyword-based discovery and filtering of portfolio content.

## The Users Portfolio Tags Object
Field Type Description tag_id integer Unique portfolio tag record ID (primary key, read-only) photo_id integer ID of the portfolio photo this tag is attached to (foreign key to users_portfolio ) tag string The tag text string (default empty string) user_id integer ID of the member who owns this portfolio tag rel_id integer ID of the related portfolio group or album record rel_db string Name of the related database/table for the portfolio group reference

## List Users Portfolio Tag Records
Returns a paginated list of users portfolio tag records.
